chat.empty.title: Your investment analyst — with household books
chat.empty.body: I analyze portfolios (live marks, playbook, undervalued screens) and can keep household books for cash flow and big decisions like buying a house. Use the Dashboard tab for portfolio value and Brokers to connect read-only IBKR Flex, Tiger, MooMoo, or Webull.
chat.empty.footer: Tables, code, and BinDrive reports render inline. Select text to quote it into your next message. Educational analysis only — not licensed financial advice.
chat.empty.starter.review_options.label: Review my options
chat.empty.starter.review_options.messag: Review my open option positions across connected brokers. Show mark versus cost, expiry, assignment exposure, and any missing data.
chat.empty.starter.explore_chain.label: Explore a call or put
chat.empty.starter.explore_chain.message: Show the nearest listed call and put chain for SPY. Pick a concrete contract from sourced data and explain premium, breakeven, time value, liquidity, and risk.
chat.empty.starter.covered_call.label: Covered call
chat.empty.starter.covered_call.message: Help me evaluate a covered call on a stock I own. Check my share position and the available chain, then compare premium, upside cap, and assignment risk.
chat.empty.starter.cash_secured_put.mess: Help me evaluate a cash-secured put on SPY using the nearest expiry. Check a concrete contract, assignment cash required, breakeven, and downside risk.
chat.empty.starter.protective_put.label: Protective put
chat.empty.starter.protective_put.messag: Help me compare a protective put for a stock I own using available option contracts. Show protection, premium cost, and expiry tradeoffs.
